notes.title: RELEASE DAY
notes.notes:
Hello everyone 
After 8 months of development we are very close to the release day. Today the game reached version 1.0  which was huge for us. We decide to offer some keys of the game earlier so that you to test it and most important give us feedback . If you want to test our game leave a comment in the comment section of this post. Keys are not guaranteed.

Thanks for testing
